messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T GekkoScience KBOX miner

Quick read: Magic Miner 40T at $799 is the best value per TH here (40 TH/s, ~650W), B30 is $899 for 30 TH/s at ~360-450W, and the KBOX is $800 for 22 TH/s at just 330W — the quietest, lowest-draw of the three and the only one shipping from the US now.

So it comes down to power and noise versus hashrate.

Where's it going to sit — living space or a basement/garage?

context.pop: Torn between the Magic (address hidden), GekkoScience KBOX and Harlo B30? I'll tell you which one fits you.
